items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 20:1
items.html: Before the sin, the First Man occupied all three worlds BYA, which ascended and became the discernment of YESHSUT and ZON of Atzilut. And after the sin the worlds were corrupted and descended below the Parsa of Atzilut. And all the limbs of the soul of the First Man fell away from him, and there remained in him only one hundred crowns, from the ten Partzufim of BYA, which are: ZON of Beriah, AVI and ZON of Yetzirah, and AVI and ZON of Assiyah. And they are called one hundred cubits. (Item 113).
